authority: Two whole source-authored neighbor controls before any native/provider observation; no change to original23 vectors.

cases.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
const items = [{}];
</script>
<template>
  <div v-for="item in items" v-bind="$attrs" />
</template>

diagnostics.message: `v-bind="$attrs"` on the root element applies the fallthrough attributes twice, because `inheritAttrs` defaults to true.
diagnostics.help: Opt out of the automatic inheritance so only this `v-bind` applies them, e.g. `defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })` or `inheritAttrs: false` in the component options.
